scope: GX emulation without GX timing; Inferix host-KV baseline, one 21-latent-frame measured request after full warmup

self_attention_conditional_relation.interpretation: A conditional fit with fixed query tokens, not a discovered dependence on query length; the tiny negative slope is not evidence that larger context reduces CPU work.

limitations: Instruction counts exclude gx_cuda.so and do not measure PCIe copy service or GPU execution time.
Marked exclusive regions do not cover all host work; the marked sum is not an end-to-end CPU cost.
One request and seven context states do not establish a general cost law or critical-path bottleneck.
